mechanic:break_mine.art_style: Split: bright simulator/stylized (about 6/12) vs dark anime or RNG glow art (about 5/12); voxel farm animals in new entries.

Dark muddy scenes where the object is hard to read

do: Show the tool mid-strike on a glowing, valuable-looking object
Use a split before/after with a red arrow for progression
Add one rarity or money number in bold outlined text
Make the broken material spray chunks toward the camera

icon_patterns.pattern: tool or machine shown (pickaxe, drill, excavator, bat)
dark dramatic background with glow/red lighting

mechanic:break_mine.newcomer_shift: NEW games use big vehicles/landscapes (excavator flattening a mountain), voxel farm animals, and $0 vs $1,000,000 split thumbnails.

mechanic:break_mine.text_usage: Light; occasional rarity percentage, WORLD 2, or $0 to $1,000,000 before/after text.

thumbnail_patterns.pattern: object being broken or dug into (eggs, mountain, ground, ragdoll)
glowing loot/rarity cue (lava eggs, gold armor, 0.00001%)
before/after or split layout with arrow

Show the tap result as a big number
Keep saturation high
